profile.headline: Software Engineer | JavaScript & React Specialist | Passionate About Building Accessible, User-Centered Applications
profile.summary: As a dedicated and collaborative Software Engineer with 5 years of experience, my goal is to leverage my technical expertise in software development to create impactful, user-centered solutions while fostering a positive and inclusive team environment. I am passionate about working closely with cross-functional teams, listening to user feedback, and continuously improving processes to deliver high-quality products that meet both business needs and user expectations. I aim to contribute to a company that values innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. My mission is to bridge the gap between design and technology by building intuitive interfaces that delight users and meet business objectives.
